// Package block_party is the on-chain page of the Block Party listing in the
// Memba App Store. The game runs in Memba; this realm holds no state.
package block_party

// Render returns the same page for every path.
func Render(_ string) string {
	return `# Block Party

*Daily chain-seeded 2048 puzzle*

A daily 2048 merge game seeded from a Gno block — everyone plays the same board. Play with no wallet; connect to save your streak and climb the leaderboard.

## How to play

- Arrow keys, or a swipe on touch screens, slide every tile.
- Two equal tiles merge into one worth their sum.
- A daily run ends when its moves run out (30, or 24 on Rush days) or when no tile can move; practice runs are unlimited.

## Scores

The Memba backend replays every move of a daily run before it enters the leaderboard, so scores are verified off-chain. This realm stores no scores.

[Play Block Party in Memba](https://memba.samourai.app/mainnet/game)
`
}

// Package space_invaders is the on-chain page of the Space Invaders listing in
// the Memba App Store. The game runs in Memba; this realm holds no state.
package space_invaders

// Render returns the same page for every path.
func Render(_ string) string {
	return `# Space Invaders

*Classic arcade shooter*

Defend the baseline across escalating waves in a browser-native Space Invaders. Play instantly with no wallet — keyboard on desktop, full touch controls on mobile. Deterministic engine, local high score.

## How to play

- Left and right arrows, or A and D, move.
- Space or W fires. P or Esc pauses. Enter launches a run.
- On touch screens, drag on the left half to steer and tap the right half to fire.

## Scores

Your high score stays in your browser. When certification is on, the Memba backend replays a daily run before it can reach the on-chain arcade board. This realm stores no scores.

[Play Space Invaders in Memba](https://memba.samourai.app/mainnet/game/space-invaders)
`
}

// Package barricade is the on-chain page of the BARRICADE listing in the Memba
// App Store. The game runs in Memba; this realm holds no state.
package barricade

// Render returns the same page for every path.
func Render(_ string) string {
	return `# BARRICADE

*Hold the Paris barricade against the machines*

A browser-native defence game in a French civic setting: hold the cobblestone barricade as waves of machines advance down three lanes. Play instantly with no wallet — a wide battlefield on desktop, a portrait front line on phones.

## How to play

- Left and right arrows, 1, 2 and 3, or a tap on a lane change lanes; you fire automatically.
- S shoves the nearest machine in your lane, R rallies, P pauses.
- M or the Molotov button aims a molotov: arrows choose lane and range and Enter throws, or tap the target.
- Between waves, spend scrap on repairs, turrets or the crowd.

## Scores

Everyone gets the same daily seed; practice runs do not count. When certification is on, the Memba backend replays a daily run before it can reach the on-chain arcade board. This realm stores no scores.

[Play BARRICADE in Memba](https://memba.samourai.app/mainnet/game/barricade)
`
}
